name: obsideo
description: Encrypted S3-compatible storage with cryptographic possession proofs. 12 GB free, signup in-conversation, credentials stay on your machine.
long_description: Give Claude durable, private object storage. Obsideo is S3-compatible storage where every stored object is replicated to 3 providers and challenge-verified with chunk-level merkle proofs on a continuous cycle. The first put creates a free no-email trial account, so storage works with nothing to configure; signing up in-conversation (email code, no card) raises the quota to 12 GB free and keeps the same account and data. Objects are encrypted client-side by default with AES-256-GCM using a locally generated, user-held key, so the platform stores ciphertext it cannot read. The verify tool challenges each provider holding an object and checks their signatures, so you can prove your bytes are still held without downloading them. This extension runs entirely on your machine: credentials and encryption keys are stored locally in ~/.obsideo/mcp.json and are never sent to or hosted by Obsideo.

tools.name: trial
tools.description: Create an instant no-email account (100 MB, proof-of-work instead of identity); storage tools auto-create one

tools.name: signup_start
tools.description: Start Obsideo signup: emails a 6-digit verification code (12 GB free, no card); claims an existing trial in place

tools.name: signup_verify
tools.description: Complete signup; keypair generated locally, credentials stored on this machine

tools.name: put
tools.description: Store a file or inline content as an object, encrypted client-side by default

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Prove the network still holds an object without downloading it, by challenging each provider directly

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Show the account plan, status and period end; changes nothing

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Get a Stripe checkout link for paid blocks; charges nothing, the human pays on Stripe's page

tools.name: portal
tools.description: Get the Stripe customer portal link: cancel, change card, download invoices

tools.name: backup_keys
tools.description: Copy credentials, signing key, encryption key and upload commitments to a path the human names
